limits: All numerical scenario inputs and their ranges are assumptions, based on previous experience.
These scenarios are not a regional geotechnical investigation or a reconstruction of any event.
Each leg is evaluated independently under an assumed vertical preload reaction.
Circular clay factor 6.34 is retained; the weak-layer paper uses 6.05 for its surface reference.
Partial engagement, plug transport, remoulding, rate effects, buoyancy and dynamics are excluded.
Static resistance recovery does not predict a dynamic plunge or arrest depth.
A false punch-through flag does not establish installation acceptance.
Independent uniform distributions are assumptions, not measured population statistics.
The top interface moves on both adjacent layers; deeper boundaries remain fixed.
Uniform clay has no top-layer interface; investigation extent remains fixed.
Probability is per leg conditional on this model; no three-leg system probability is inferred.
Punching coefficient is fixed at an assumed 1.5; its uncertainty is excluded.
